label: Fires at D2 when a2 reaches S1 (rare), growing through the episode; silent on a1->S2.
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo
explanation: D2-only feature whose magnitude is set by the current trial transition, observed at D2 (in_action, in_state): large (about 2 above baseline, rising with ep_trial to about 4-5 late) when a2 led to S1 (rare), zero on a1->S2, and the per-decile D2 baseline (growing late-episode drift) carries the common a1->S1/a2->S2 level; the a1->S2*ep_trial term removes that drift where the feature stays silent. Within the situation where the model needs it (D2 after a previous a2 S1 rewarded trial) the grading is the same: it is high if the agent repeated a2 and again landed on S1 (rare), low if a2 went to S2 (common) or a1 was chosen; multiplying the a2->S1 term by last_is(a2 S1 r) raises within-situation R^2 contribution from 0.001 (situation mean) to 0.042 of total variance, i.e. the current transition, not the previous-trial pattern, drives it. The free fit adds belief_lo terms (lower when the observer believes S1 is good, i.e. larger when S1 reached against an S2 belief) for a small gain (0.89 vs 0.86 dev). Previous reward and history beyond the current transition add little.

issues: The recorded short form's third term (a2->S1 x ep_trial) adds very little. a2->S1 alone scores 0.788 test, and adding a2->S1 x ep_trial brings it only to 0.802. Almost all of the gain up to 0.865 comes from the negative a1->S2 x ep_trial term (a2->S1 plus that term: 0.851). So 'growing through the episode' on a2->S1 is a minor effect, and the a1->S2 term is a fitted correction for baseline drift, not a description of what the feature does.

Running misses on the recorded short form shows a large systematic error. Late in the episode (t90+), common a1->S1 at D2 is predicted at about 2.87 but the actual value is about 0.9-1.7. D2 after any a1 trial is over-predicted by about -0.31 to -0.36. The D2 timing baseline (about 3.0 in the last decile) comes from a2 trials. The feature's late-episode rise happens on a2 trials only; both a1 transitions stay low.

The label leaves out the late-episode activity on common a2->S2, which the earlier firing label already noted (fires after about trial 40, up to about 0.5 of max). It also implies the only graded variable is ep_trial on a2->S1.

Making the correction an a1-specific drift, (in_action == 1) * ep_trial, fixes the error. a2->S1 plus a1 x ep_trial scores 0.903 test, and adding a2->S1 x ep_trial scores 0.917 test, above the free fit (0.891) and the additive ceiling (0.91). After this change the remaining errors are small (phase means between -0.10 and +0.05).
skeptic.revised_label: D2 only: strong on rare a2->S1; grows late-episode on a2 choices, stays low after a1.

final_label: D2 only: strong on rare a2->S1; grows late-episode on a2 choices, stays low after a1.
